notes: Quiz question types (v2.3): besides the three-choice meaning question you can now answer in reverse (Chinese to word, with look-alike word distractors), listen (the word is only spoken, with replay) or spell (type the word; case and spaces do not matter and a near miss is marked from the first wrong character). Phrases and sentence patterns keep the choice question. Records gains a statistics sheet: saved/reviewed/accuracy/due tiles, mastery per CEFR level, a 30-day accuracy line drawn as pure SVG (days with no reviews are gaps, not zeros) and the most-missed words, each one opening its entry.
